topic: Someone finds their grandmother's engagement ring in a pawn shop
text: I heard tell of a ring, found in a pawn shop, a glint of old gold that held stories of days long gone. They say it was the ring that sealed the promise for your grandmother, the one who taught me to mend socks with patience and a steady hand. To think it lay hidden, a treasure among trinkets, waiting for the right eyes to recognize its worth. It’s like the land, you see, giving up its secrets when the time is right, just when the soil is warm and ready to share. I reckon finding such a thing is a bit of a miracle, a sign that the saints are weaving their threads into our tapestry, reminding us of the stories that bind us to the earth and to each other.
